MODULE 01 — STRINGREVEAL
0→1 STAGGER EASED

Elements enter as they travel into view.

Each card publishes its own entry progress, mapped to opacity, rise and a staggered cascade — composing the whole row's choreography from pure scroll.

/01

OPACITY

Fade from invisible to fully present as the entry timeline advances.

/02

TRANSLATE

Rise 64px into place along a custom cubic-bezier curve.

/03

STAGGER

Offset entry points cascade the cards naturally down the row.
